title: Crash Team Racing Nitro-Fueled online is under study on OpenPak
body: We are looking into how Crash Team Racing Nitro-Fueled's online services should work on OpenPak. Nothing is promised yet: some of its online features may not need OpenPak at all, and we are still checking what the game needs from a console. There are no online dates or features to share at this stage.
footer: OpenPak Crash Team Racing — under study, not promised.
